data.name: RushLife
data.detailed_description:
RushLife is a high-pressure life simulation where every hour counts, every decision matters, and every job is a skill-based challenge.  over 50 Minigames

You are dropped into a living system where time, money, and survival are constantly working against you.

Every move costs hours.
Every mistake has consequences.
Every dollar must be earned.

There are no shortcuts.
There is no idle progression.
There is no safety net.

🔁 A LIFE SIMULATION BUILT ON PRESSURE

Each in-game week is a balancing act:

  • 🕒 Spend limited hours moving across the city

  • 🍔 Eat or suffer health penalties

  • 🛏️ Sleep or face collapse

  • 💼 Work to earn money

  • 🗺️ Plan your route — because movement itself costs time

You cannot do everything.

So what do you sacrifice?

🗺️ THE CITY IS A SYSTEM

The world is not decoration — it’s a cost engine.

  • Every tile costs time

  • Travel depends on your transport

  • Every location is a fully interactive system

From housing and jobs to hospitals, courts, casinos, and more — everything is connected.

🎮 SKILL-BASED MINIGAMES DRIVE YOUR LIFE

This is not a menu simulator.

Your success depends on how well you play.

  • Nail timing in fast food

  • React under pressure in chaotic environments

  • Manage risk in high-stakes systems

  • Build accuracy and combos to maximise income

👉 Perform well → earn more → survive
👉 Perform poorly → consequences hit immediately

💼 CAREERS WITH REAL PROGRESSION

Choose your path and work your way up:

  • Multiple careers with unique gameplay

  • Increasing difficulty and rewards

  • Skill-based performance systems

You don’t just pick a job — you learn how to perform it.

⏱️ TIME IS YOUR MOST VALUABLE RESOURCE

Everything costs time.

Movement.
Work.
Recovery.
Mistakes.

👉 You cannot optimise everything.

Every decision is a tradeoff.

⚖️ CONSEQUENCES ARE REAL

Fail to manage your life, and the system responds:

  • 🏥 Hospital visits

  • ⚖️ Fines and legal trouble

  • 🚓 Police intervention

  • 🔒 Jail time

  • 💸 Financial collapse

👉 You live with your decisions.

🎯 KEY FEATURES

  • Turn-based gameplay for up to 4 local players

  • Deep, interconnected life simulation systems

  • Large city map with meaningful travel decisions

  • Multiple careers with unique minigames

  • Skill-based gameplay that directly affects progression

  • Economy, survival, and time management systems

  • High replayability with different strategies and outcomes

🔥 ONE MORE WEEK. ONE MORE CHANCE.

Can you manage your time, master the systems, and stay ahead of the pressure?

Or will life catch up with you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Processor: 2.0 GHz dual-core processor - Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Graphics: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Processor: 2.5 GHz dual-core or better - Recommended: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Graphics: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
